title: Frame
description: One raw normalized unit of observation. Immutable, append-only, redacted before persistence.

seq.description: Monotonic within capture; the only ordering the correlator trusts within a capture

channel.description: Socket pair, pipe name, log source, file path

kind_hint.description: Transport-level hint; normalize/ decides the final Observation kind

payload.description: Redacted, normalized payload. Credential material is <REDACTED> or ~:pseudonym before this object exists.

raw_ref.description: Content-addressed blob ref (sha256[:16]) into the capture store
